incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered - CapacityAlert - queue=inference-worker-queue backlog-ms=320000 > threshold(300000) - affected-cells=cell-3
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification sent to `mike` (primary on-call). Incident link: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/P12345
mike: got it, acknowledging now
pagerduty: Mike acknowledged the page (P12345) :white_check_mark:
mike: quick summary? what saturated — pods or hosts?
kendall: looks like continuous enqueue rate spike from a customer job, backlog spiked. autoscaler didn't open new nodes fast enough. Seeing OOMs on a couple pods and POD_PENDING due to node quota
anya: logs from router show a flood of retries and a lot of 429s to the inference runtime, traces show long `queue_wait` for requests
samir: `kubectl top nodes` shows CPU at ~98% on nodes in cell-3. Autoscaler attempted scale but was rejected: "quota controller: quota exceeded"
julia: customer impact: EU region reports 5-10s tail latency increases and ~1-2% retries per minute. Two high-value accounts crossing SLOs — customer success notified
mike: ok mitigation plan: (1) open manual burst capacity (+10 GPUs) from dedicated-burst, (2) evict low-priority batch jobs from cell-3, (3) adjust traffic-split to direct a portion to fallback smaller-quantized model for non-critical routes
anya: executing burst: `infra-cli bursts create --pool inference-burst --gpus 10 --ttl 30m` — following runbook step
incident-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/queue-overflow
mike: also thinking short-term tweak to autoscaler to ignore transient quota blips, but won't change that yet — need immediate actions first
kendall: deleting a few background batchjobs now: `kubectl delete job -l batch=background -n batch` — should free ~3 GPUs from cell-3
samir: partial workaround: updating traffic-split to send 20% EU->us-west until capacity stabilizes. Patch applied: `kubectl apply -f traffic-split-eu-temp.yaml`
julia: preparing customer comms for status page and direct notices to impacted accounts. Draft: "We are mitigating increased latency due to capacity saturation; temporary routing and burst capacity applied. No data loss expected. ETA 20-30m."
mike: send the update. ETA 20-30m to stabilization.
pagerduty: PagerDuty escalation timer: 2 minutes to escalation if no further ack (currently acknowledged)
incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: queue_length per-cell: {cell-1:12s, cell-2:8s, cell-3:320s}; active_retries: 1.4k; inflight_jobs: 3.8k
kendall: manual cleanup succeeded — freed ~3 GPUs, node pressure decreasing, pods starting to reschedule
anya: burst creation succeeded — 10 GPUs added to inference-burst pool, new instances reporting Ready in ~90s
mike: monitoring. If backlog != <60s in 10m we'll initiate forced pod eviction for non-critical services and escalate to infra for temporary quota bump
julia: posted status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-023 (customers notified)
mike: assigning postmortem owner: kendall; timeline collector: anya; customer comms owner: julia
samir: temporary routing is causing ~1.6x p95 in us-west but EU p95 is trending down, overall tail latency improving
mike: great. staying on until fully stable :eyes:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P12345 acknowledged by mike at 2026-03-15T22:13:21Z
